description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function named 'smarty_modifiercompiler_unescape' which compiles code for the 'unescape' modifier used within Smarty templates. It handles unescaping various HTML entities and URL encodings based on parameters, utilizing Smarty's internal plugin system and character set configurations.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_unescape
methods.description: Compiles PHP code for the 'unescape' modifier in Smarty templates, selecting the appropriate unescaping function based on parameters such as 'entity', 'htmlall', 'html', or 'url'.
